title: Bragulla et al. 2026 — N2 5.0 gas-washing ammonia check (reproduction)
description: The house N2 5.0 supply was bubbled at 10 mL/min for 21.53 h through 50 mL of 0.2 M H2SO4 and the trap analysed by IC (14.8 µg/L NH4+). The authors report the corresponding gas contamination as 80 ppb_mol NH3. This record checks that the reported 80 ppb bound and the trap amount are arithmetically consistent on a common nmol-N basis. It is circular by design (the 80 ppb value was derived from this measurement) and is therefore a reproduction check, not independent evidence. Gas temperature and pressure are not stated and are assumed.
